But we don't have it. The previous step make_5_lvl2-apply_template-4 answer was [] meaning no precursors found for some template search. We need to search template catalog for this reaction. Use search_template_catalog_by_criteria with criteria: functional_groups_broken: ["phosphonate","alkyne?"] Actually reaction: forms C=C, forms ester, breaks C-P, C-O, C-C, alkyne triple to single. Functional groups formed: alkene, ester. Broken: phosphonate, alkyne? maybe "alkyne". Use bonds_order_changed: ["C-C (3.0->2.0)"] but not sure.

Simplify: search with functional_groups_formed=["alkene","carboxylic_ester"], functional_groups_broken=["phosphonate","alkyne"].
